title: Paris vs Rome: Which Should You Visit?
description: A data-backed comparison of Paris and Rome based on Reddit discussions, real costs, weather data, and traveler preferences.

categories.title: 🌤️ Weather & Best Time to Visit
categories.summary: Paris and Rome have very different climates — Paris is northern European oceanic (grey winters, warm summers, rain year-round), while Rome has a Mediterranean climate (hot dry summers, mild winters, most rain in fall and spring). This makes Rome the winner for comfort in most seasons.

faqs.question: Is Paris or Rome better for first-time visitors to Europe?
faqs.answer: Both are quintessential first-time European cities, but they offer genuinely different experiences. Reddit's general consensus: Rome wins for history and outdoor sightseeing — you can wander and stumble upon 2,000-year-old ruins for free. faqs.question: Is Paris more expensive than Rome?
faqs.answer: Yes, significantly. Paris is one of Europe's most expensive cities. A mid-range hotel in Paris runs €150–250/night vs €100–180/night in Rome. faqs.question: Which city has better food, Paris or Rome?
faqs.answer: This is the most hotly contested question in travel. Rome wins on casual, everyday eating — a €1.50 espresso standing at a bar, €1 suppli (fried rice balls), excellent pizza al taglio (by the slice), fresh pasta (cacio e pepe, carbonara, amatriciana) at trattorias for €12–18. faqs.question: How many days do you need in Paris vs Rome?
faqs.answer: Minimum 3 full days in each to see highlights without rushing. Ideally 4–5 days each for a comfortable pace. faqs.question: What is the best time of year to visit Paris and Rome?
faqs.answer: For both cities: April–June and September–October are the sweet spots — mild weather, manageable crowds, and the cities at their most beautiful. faqs.answer: Both are generally safe but have specific risks. Paris: pickpocketing is a serious issue at major tourist spots (Eiffel Tower, Sacré-Cœur, metro lines 1 and RER B to CDG airport). faqs.question: Should I visit Paris or Rome first if doing both?
faqs.answer: Most travelers who do both visit Paris first (as a gateway from long-haul flights to Charles de Gaulle) then take the train to Rome, or fly between them. faqs.question: Which city is more walkable, Paris or Rome?
faqs.answer: Both are highly walkable by European standards. Rome is more compact — the historic center (Centro Storico) can be walked across in 20–30 minutes, and many major sights are within walking distance of each other. faqs.question: Is Paris or Rome better in winter?
faqs.answer: Rome wins on weather in winter — temperatures average 12–15°C vs Paris's 7–10°C, with significantly more sunshine and shorter museum queues.
